app.subtitle: Minecraft: Java Edition launcher
profiles.title: Profiles
profile.name: Name
account.offlineNote: “Offline (test)” is a development mode: no sign-in, online servers unavailable. Playing requires a Minecraft: Java Edition license; Microsoft sign-in is coming in a later version.
settings.onStart.hide: Hide the launcher (returns after the game exits)
settings.concurrencyHint: Higher is faster on a good connection; lower is more stable on a weak one.
settings.repairNote: Verification checks the SHA1 of every version, asset and Java file and re-downloads anything missing or corrupted.
settings.glowHint: Pulse and shimmer effects. Static glow still applies when strength is above zero. System reduced-motion always disables animations.
state.notInstalled: Version not installed yet — files will be downloaded on launch
crash.title: The game crashed
crash.hint: Last lines of the game log. See the crash report (crash-reports) or the Log tab for details.
crash.noLog: The game did not write anything to the log.
confirm.deleteText: Profile “{name}” will be removed from the list. Installed Minecraft versions are kept.
confirm.deleteFiles: Also delete the profile's game folder (worlds, options, screenshots)
toast.pickVersion: Open “Edit” and choose a Minecraft version for this profile.
error.network: No internet connection or Mojang servers are unreachable. Check your network and try again — already downloaded files are kept.
error.disk: Not enough disk space: about {needMb} MB more needed, {freeMb} MB free. Free up space and retry.
error.permission: Access denied to {path}. Check permissions or your antivirus.
error.username: Invalid player name: 3–16 characters, letters, digits and “_”.
error.javaNotFound: Java not found or does not start: {path}. Check the path or choose “Automatic”.
error.javaPathRequired: Enter a Java path or choose “Use global setting”.
error.notImplemented: This feature is coming in a later version.
error.profileLast: The last profile cannot be deleted.
error.alreadyRunning: This profile is already running or being verified.
error.versionNotFound: Version not found locally or in Mojang's list.
error.checksum: A file was corrupted during download (checksum mismatch). Please retry.
error.notFound: File not found on Mojang's server (404).
error.server: Mojang's server is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.resolution: Enter both width and height (or leave both empty).
modpack.importTitle: Install a Modrinth modpack (.mrpack) file as a new profile
modpack.doneMsg: New profile created: {files} files, {overrides} from overrides.
loader.forgeHint: Forge is installed via its official installer (processors run automatically, 1–3 min). The Forge project asks for support: patreon.com/LexManos.
loader.neoforgeHint: NeoForge is installed via its official installer (processors run automatically).
mods.modrinthNote: Catalogue and files come from Modrinth (api.modrinth.com). SHA-1 and SHA-512 hashes are verified on install.
mods.noLoader: This profile has no mod loader. Choose Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge in the profile settings (Edit), otherwise mods won't load.
mods.shaderNote: Shaders only work with a shader mod (e.g. Iris for Fabric/Quilt, or OptiFine). The launcher just puts files into shaderpacks.
mods.modpackNote: A modpack installs as a new profile with its own Minecraft version and loader. You can also import a .mrpack file (button on the left).
mods.identifyOffline: Couldn't reach Modrinth — files are shown without details.
mods.empty.mod: No mods yet. Find some in “Search Modrinth”.
mods.removeText: “{name}” will be removed from the profile.
storage.title: Disk usage
storage.nothing: Nothing to remove — everything is used by profiles.
storage.confirmText: {count} items ({size}) will be removed. Files needed by any profile are kept. Profile folders (worlds, mods) are not touched.
storage.skipped: Part of the scan was skipped for safety: {list}
storage.note: Only shared files (versions, libraries, Java, assets) not referenced by any profile are removed. Cleanup is unavailable while a game is running.
error.loaderUnavailable: The selected loader isn't available for this Minecraft version.
error.loaderProcessor: The loader installer failed (a processor exited with an error). See the Log tab for details.
error.noCompatibleVersion: No version compatible with this profile (Minecraft version / loader).
error.mrpackInvalid: The modpack file is damaged or not supported.
error.cleanupBusy: Close running games and wait for installs to finish first.
error.cleanupStale: The list is outdated — press “Find unused files” again.
update.title: Launcher updates
update.downloaded: Version {version} is downloaded and will be installed on restart.
update.reason.dev: Auto-update only works in a packaged build.
update.reason.notConfigured: No update repository is configured — check the releases page for new versions.
update.reason.macUnsigned: This macOS build is not signed, so auto-update is unavailable. Download new versions from the releases page.
update.reason.unsupportedPackage: Auto-update is not available for this package type (deb, tar.gz, portable zip) — update via the package or the releases page.
error.updateNotReady: The update has not been downloaded yet.
error.updateGameRunning: Close running games, then restart the launcher to update.
update.state.noReleases: No releases have been published yet — you are up to date.
